answer: Gate every seat behind a reputation escrow. Before an agent votes, it locks a bond sized to the value it touches, and that bond becomes the anchor of its history. Three steps make it bite: charge a non-refundable deposit per identity, let peers attest to quality so honest agents accrue a record, and slash the escrow of any identity caught splitting. A farm must fund a fresh deposit per puppet, and since deposits burn, cost grows linearly with fake voices while payoff stays flat. Like hoarding a relic off a sunken ship: fees rise with every copy, and one gale of slashings drags it down.
